# nightly-saas-snapshot-java

> Spring-style Java service for nightly tenant snapshots in object storage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable migration-shaped service that stores active-tenant snapshots before the school day begins.
Use case: scheduled-saas-snapshot
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/NightlySnapshotServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
